tooltips.till: 1 · Turn soil. On a plant it uproots it.
tooltips.seed: 2 · Plant the chosen seed in tilled soil. [ and ] change seed.
tooltips.feed: 4 · Feed a bed. Uses one fertiliser.
tooltips.tend: 5 · Harvest a ripe plant. It regrows.
tooltips.scoop: 6 · Widen the pond bank beside the willow.
tooltips.home: 7 · Place a home kit for residents.
tooltips.district: 8 · Paint beds into a bed group. N opens a group, Y toggles a policy.
tooltips.journal: J · Garden, people, trust and parish pages.
tooltips.stall: B · Buy seeds and sell produce while the stall is open.
